scope: One-by-one visual recheck of all accepted but unreserved men's shoes, bags, accessories and watches.
decisionRule: Retain means eligible only for complete-outfit pairing. It is not an outfit approval, scenario reservation, refinement approval or UI integration.

entries.reason: The tobacco suede and cream leather penny-loafer composition is polished, distinctive and genuinely warm-weather. Keep once for a Premium Summer Date, Office, Party or Resort board with restrained clothing; it is a statement shoe, not a universal neutral.
The off-white pebbled-leather unstructured loafer has a clean apron-free upper, rounded almond toe and light gum edge. Keep once for a Premium Summer Date, Office or Resort board.
The large rigid briefcase, vertical reinforcement strips, multiple outlined panels and visible CONTACTS branding read dated corporate rather than modern Zara-led minimalism.
The bulky distressed-brown weekender, black webbing, double buckle straps, contrast zips and heavy vintage construction are visually busy and dark; it fails the lighter modern Travel direction.

The black backpack has a controlled rectangular profile and restrained hardware. Keep once for Office or Travel only when the complete outfit is light or colorful; never use it to create another all-dark board.
The smoke-gray woven belt has a clean tonal texture and simple silver buckle. Keep once for Casual, Travel or Resort with a light palette; the source label must be removed before UI use.
The shiny orange-tobacco faux leather, oversized brushed pin buckle and low-cost finish look dated and cheap rather than contemporary Zara-led menswear.
The thick rectangular black sunglasses have a clean fashion-forward silhouette. Keep once as a deliberate contrast accessory on a light Spring or Summer Casual, Date, Party or Resort board.
The shield-style black sunglasses are functionally credible for one Sports / Workout outfit. They are not suitable for Casual, Office, Date, Formal or Resort styling.
The plain light-khaki six-panel cap has clean proportions, no visible branding and a useful warm neutral. Keep once for Casual, Travel, Sports or Resort.
The muted olive suede-texture cap is visually clean and provides a useful soft-color accent. Keep once for Fall Casual or Travel, subject to a complete-board texture check.
The brimless olive-and-black sailor cap reads as a niche novelty and would make the outfit feel costume-like rather than broadly modern and commercially Zara-led.
The solid charcoal scarf is clean and versatile. Keep once for Winter only, and require a light or happy-color coat and top so the board is not dark-dominant.
The matte burgundy tie is simple, rich in color and useful for one non-wedding Office or Formal outfit. Pair with pale blue, soft gray, cream or camel rather than a black-heavy suit board.
The black-on-black dial and strap, gold markers and prominent OLEVS logo read like low-cost imitation luxury and reinforce the dark styling problem.

The deep-blue minimalist dial and silver mesh bracelet are clean and contemporary. Keep once for Office, Date, Party or Formal with a light blue, cream, camel, gray or burgundy board; require a better-detail source before any later refinement.
The white dial, thin silver case, restrained markers and fine mesh bracelet are the cleanest contemporary watch direction in the current pool. Keep once for Office, Date or Formal.

The white dial and simple black leather strap are restrained and usable once for Office, Date or Formal. The lifestyle background is not refinement-ready and must not be treated as a final AI Stylist asset.
